speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) due to natalizumab therapy. The combination of acquired ataxia, your history of Crohn's disease, and treatment with natalizumab (a known risk factor for PML) makes this the most critical diagnosis to rule out. We need to review the MRI images immediately to look for characteristic non-enhancing white matter lesions in the posterior brain regions.
